marks.q: In the medium term, the Company expects Adjusted EBIT (EBITA)[4] margin at constant scope of consolidation to continue to improve moderately until the completion of the potential acquisition of MultiChoice Group, as a result of cost optimisation, operating leverage and the expected transition to profitability of newly-integrated assets transferred from Vivendi.
Reflecting the performance of the first quarter of 2025, CANAL+ confirms its full year 2025 outlook released on 4 March 2025[6].
Mid-year, the Company is in a position to confirm its 2025 outlook on revenue and EBITA, with a material 2025 one-off cash improvement and structural cash improvements expected for the future.

Our focus on profitability and cash has started delivering structural improvements, put us in a strong position at the half year, and enabled us to confirm our upgraded guidance for both EBITA and CFFO for 2025.
Finally, and most importantly, I am pleased to confirm we remain on track to deliver our full year guidance on revenue, EBITA and cash.

As a result of these achievements and of our relentless focus on improving our value proposition while reducing costs, we delivered revenues in-line with our guidance and exceeded our expectations on profitability and cash.
We continue to deliver cost synergies resulting from the acquisition of MultiChoice, in line with our plans, and we reiterate our full-year 2026 guidance.
We have achieved half of our €250m synergies target and remain well on track for the year, and we confirm our full-year and medium-term guidance.
We remain well on track to achieve our 2026 synergies target and deliver our full-year guidance.
